summary: This filing is a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a proposed public offering of senior notes due 2031 by Redwood Trust Inc. The registrant is the issuer, not a party to a special-situations transaction. The document describes the terms of the notes, including interest rate, maturity, redemption provisions, and underwriting arrangements. There is no mention of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction.
